title: Speech in the Wild
welcome_lead: How presenters, teachers and friends shape their speech.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on speech contexts and analysis.
final_note: You can now analyse a short transcript for speech features.

concepts.def: Stress, tone and rhythm of speech.

walkthroughs.body_html: A transcript writes down speech with pauses (…), overlaps and repairs. It shows messiness that polished writing hides.
Prosody covers stress, rhythm and intonation. A rising tone can turn a statement into a question.
Speakers adapt to context: classroom vs canteen, parent vs friend. Spotting context explains every choice in a transcript.
